product_changes: Forum Edition 1.3.8: on-demand ACP AI Insights for consent-approved, anonymous event rollups; read-only verified evidence, configurable UTC date ranges and event-series selection; OpenAI Responses explanations through existing quota/budget machinery with a dedicated strict system role, output validation, evidence ID binding and removal of transient transcripts; integrity and live ACL rechecks, optional CSV export and interactive chart drilldown. No database migration, raw-event/user disclosure or autonomous administration.

Forum Edition 1.3.7: moderator-initiated AI review for existing report and premoderation cases. Billed OpenAI Responses advice returns validated risk categories, grounded evidence and suggested human review only. Effective board ACL, live content and optimistic case revision are rechecked before and after the provider call; non-public content requires explicit disclosure. Redaction, 30-day advice expiry, bounded retention cleanup, isolated temporary transcripts and SQL audit. Migration 0088. No automatic deletion, sanction, approval or moderation resolution.

Forum Edition 1.3.6: opt-in AI Writing Assistant for topics, replies and edits using real OpenAI Responses and the existing atomic quotas/budgets, temporary isolated transcripts, source-preserving transformations and confirm-before-apply previews. No automatic publishing or database migration.
Forum Edition 1.3.5: member-owned support tickets, operator queue and replies, opt-in public-grounded AI answers, strict ticket ACL, human escalation and versioned FAQ in Forum ACP. Migration 0087.

Forum Edition 1.3.4: live SQLite source-to-FTS trigger sync, native PostgreSQL/MySQL FTS persistence, verified index parity and missing-trigger diagnostics, source-driven transactional repair/reindex on SQLite, canonical native index recreation on PostgreSQL/MySQL, ranked diversified AI search evidence with term-centered live excerpts and revision revalidation. Mandatory real-PDO and SQL regressions for create/update/delete/restore, index corruption and repair. No new schema migration; CI and staging certification required.

Forum Edition 1.3.3: real AI search over indexed title/post candidates with live member and anonymous ACL intersection, public-only provider context, published-post evidence, server-generated post/page URLs, numeric citation integrity checks, SSE Responses, inherited budget and token limits and isolated ephemeral search sessions with crash recovery. Requires migration 0086 for PostgreSQL, MySQL/MariaDB or SQLite and independent CI/staging acceptance.

Forum Edition 1.3.2: Contextual Thread Assistant with server-side current ACL and guest-public verification, first and recent 23 live post snippets, summary/explanation/freeform questions over real OpenAI Responses SSE, owner+thread-scoped durable conversations, verifiable server-derived post/page anchors, deleted-post exclusion, prompt-injection isolation, strict limits and shared core cost controls. Requires migration 0085 on PostgreSQL, MySQL/MariaDB or SQLite and successful CI/staging; no private or members-only thread content sent to OpenAI.

Forum Edition 1.3.1: real session-gated member AI chat with streamed OpenAI Responses, per-member independent conversations, history/rename/delete, ACL-limited ACP configuration, per-day request and monthly token quotas, atomic generation leases, shared hard monetary budget reservations, secret isolation, provider-failure rollback and migration 0084 across PostgreSQL/MySQL/SQLite. CMS AI conversations are never exposed to forum members; Chat does not read forum topics until Contextual Thread Assistant/Search releases. Requires independent CI and staging before production acceptance.

Forum Edition 1.3.0: Analytics & Metrics Stable. Executable production acceptance of real SQL-backed event recording, one-use HMAC page receipts, same-origin checks, transactional rollup, live dashboard and bounded recalculation, event and aggregate retention, aborted publication rollback and engagement queries across SQLite, PostgreSQL, MySQL and MariaDB. Native client now binds approved path and pagination and revalidates after delayed consent or history changes. CI rejects failed real-database checks; publish requires a separately certified signed release, staging and operator approval. No new migration or identifier.

Forum Edition 1.2.11: analytics security and hardening. Strict HTTPS/same-origin/Fetch-Metadata/JSON requirements for one-use native page-view receipts reject malformed or cross-site collection; ACP engagement reports suppress 1–4 member registration cohorts and small retention/funnel denominators without misleading zeroes; contributor-day aggregates are computed in bounded SQL before streaming to PHP, reducing rows transferred for high-traffic forums while preserving exact post/topic/reply counts and same-day two-post activation. Regression coverage includes PHP origin checks, SQL grouping and ACP privacy output. Native browser collector retries transient backend failures once with the same one-use receipt and cancels retries on consent withdrawal. Existing transactional ledger, worker idempotency, role-gated ACP and 90/365-day retention continue unchanged. No new database migration or tracking identifier.

Forum Edition 1.2.10: real contribution-based engagement and registration-cohort retention in ACP. Calculates unique active authors and daily contributions, new topics vs replies, weekly returning authors, mature D+1/D+7/D+30 publishing retention, sequential 7-day first/second post activation funnel, interactive author trend graph and CSV. Uses existing member roles and surviving published posts in read-only bounded SQL; migration 0083 adds activity/cohort indexes on PostgreSQL, MySQL and SQLite. No new cookies, visitor tracking identifiers or synthetic unique visits; private source identities never leave the service. Existing anonymous event dashboard and permission gates remain intact.

Forum Edition 1.2.9: functional first-party analytics dashboard in Forum ACP with approved date ranges up to 365 retained UTC days, server-consistent aggregate plus pending ledger reads, full-window prior-period comparisons only where retained data exists, daily event series, category and weekday drilldowns, responsive SVG graphs and anonymous CSV export. Permission scoped to forum:acp:settings; maintenance remains separately authorized. No new database migrations or external SDKs.

Forum Edition 1.2.8: production UTC daily SQL counters with transactionally idempotent batch ingestion of native anonymous events, consistent snapshot reports combining applied rollups with live pending rows, 90-day processed raw retention and 365-day daily history, bounded authenticated ACP recalculation of full raw-retained date ranges, permissioned operations and audited maintenance, scheduled recovery-safe processing, migration 0082 for SQLite/PostgreSQL/MySQL and integration/SQL regression tests.

Forum Edition 1.2.7: real first-party native analytics collects anonymous consent-approved indexable public forum page views using signed 30-minute one-use receipts and an HTTPS same-origin POST, verifies and deduplicates them in the existing transactional SQL ledger, combines with committed forum publishing/reactions/search/download events, and presents UTC daily and per-event 7/30/90-day reports in permission-scoped Forum ACP; 90-day bounded cleanup and no new SQL migrations; external analytics remain optional.

Forum Edition 1.2.6: Matomo, Plausible and GTM forum event destinations dispatched through the existing consent-gated providers on ACL-verified public forum pages, with ACP configuration, per-event disable, strict validation, sanitized URLs, trusted attachment/outbound clicks, browser/PHP regression tests, and preserved GA4/Metrica rules; Cloudflare Web Analytics is integrated for its supported pageview/RUM beacon only, with sensitive-query suppression. No new SDK or database migration.

Forum Edition 1.2.5: real consent-gated GA4 forum custom-event dispatch on independently server-approved public SSR index/board/thread and paginated views, trusted attachment/outbound clicks, ACP-configurable validated unique GA4 event names (default active only when forum analytics itself is explicitly enabled), single inherited gtag.js and GA4 reporting connection, no private route instrumentation and no database migration; executable PHP/browser release regressions.

Forum Edition 1.2.4: production Yandex Metrica forum-specific goal dispatch on approved public SSR index/board/thread and paginated views, real outbound/attachment click actions, revision-checked ACP goal configuration, per-page operator validated goal identifiers, consent/ACL/CSP controls, browser and PHP regression coverage; reuses the existing single Metrica tag with no private route instrumentation or schema migration.

Forum Edition 1.2.3: consent-aware public visitor tracking with server-approved SSR route markers, exact URL/path gating, page-number-only query sanitization, once-per-navigation GA4/Metrika dispatch, duplicate activation fix, back/forward and BFCache handling, denial/revocation fail-closed behavior, isolated Chromium/Firefox regressions and unchanged CajeerEngine 2.1.0 core. No new SQL migrations.
